d: Steve Wright killed five women over a six-week period in the winter of 2006 without motive or explanation.
When a mother and her step-daughter go missing, investigators zero in on an unlikely suspect who almost commits a perfect crime.
Who would want to shoot well known nice guy Trenton Mallory? Detectives wonder if his Trading Trent empire has become his downfall.

A series of over sixty spectacular fires rip through California’s San Joaquin Valley, killing four people and devastating the landscape. An extensive investigation by the ATF, police and forensic scientists reveals a common pattern among all the blazes.

A double homicide in Hudson, Wisconsin, leaves a small-town reeling and two young detectives with little to go on. Richard Walter, the famed criminal profiler, becomes intrigued by the cold case and narrows the suspect list down to one man.
Peter Sutcliffe, also known as The Yorkshire Ripper, was convicted of killing thirteen women and attempting to murder seven others.
Ian Huntley abducted two ten-year-old schoolgirls, Holly Wells and Jessica Chapman, murdered them and tried to burn the bodies.
Fred and Rose West raped, tortured and killed young women in their house of horrors, including their own daughter.
A family man is found shot to death and dumped in a rural orchard; it looks like a carjacking.
Jennifer Cave's body is found by her stepfather in an Austin, Texas condo. What follows is a manhunt that leads authorities across the Mexican border to find the truth.
An unsolved shooting in 2003 is linked to two similar murders, a decade later. Ballistics evidence links all three to an unusual bullet type - and even more unusual murder weapons.
Randy Stone is the sort of big-hearted, outgoing guy everybody likes. So how did he end up shot to death on the floor of his Independence, Missouri insurance office?
The heaviest judgments on convicted killers are reserved for those who premeditate murder.
These are love stories with bleak, bloody endings.
Deadly Women are not the women you expect.
Love can be beautiful, love can be blind, and love can be deadly.
The random murder of a woman in Central Montana sends law enforcement on the hunt for a killer.
A heartbroken millionaire marries a much younger woman who turns out to be Mrs. Wrong. The end result is a shotgun blast to the stomach and a lethal dose of poison.
Cops in suburban Fort Worth, Texas, investigate a brutal killing at a construction site.
A deranged man, with an unforgettable nickname, terrorizes New York City in the late 1970s, leaving a trail of dead and wounded in his wake.
Police investigate the murder of a missing woman whose body was left by an abandoned farmhouse.
